title: MrJ-ArduinoRailwayFX — bus type catalogue
description: UI descriptor for each bus type served by /api/bus-types. Defines the editable fields shown in the bus editor. Each key is a bus type identifier matching config.json buses[].type.

fieldType.description: gpio: integer 0-39 (GPIO pin). number: generic integer with its own min/max range.

fieldDef.description: Descriptor for one editable field in the bus editor form.

key.description: JSON key used in config.json buses[busKey][key] (e.g. 'mosi', 'tx', 'baud').

label.description: Human-readable label shown next to the input field in the UI.

placeholder.description: Default / suggested value pre-filled when adding a new bus.

busTypeDef.description: UI descriptor for one bus type.

label.description: Display name shown in the bus-type picker and bus card header.

fields.description: Ordered list of editable fields for this bus type. Controls what the bus editor renders.
